description: Deterministic trade arithmetic over numbers you supply: landed cost, trade margin, break-even price, or the effect of a USD move. Nothing is sourced — there is no free source for duty rates, freight or insurance, so an input you omit is excluded from the total and reported in `missing`, never defaulted to zero. Use price.latest first if you want a benchmark price to pass as unit_price.

amount.description: fx_impact: amount held in the foreign currency.

buy_price.description: trade_margin, break_even: purchase price per unit.

calculation.description: Which calculation to run. Example: landed_cost.

duty_rate_pct.description: landed_cost: your import duty rate, percent. Example: 8.

freight_usd.description: landed_cost: your freight cost. Omit and it is reported missing, not assumed zero.

fx_rate.description: landed_cost: units of quote_currency per USD. fx_impact: the rate to shock.

incoterm.description: landed_cost: decides which costs your price already carries, so it shapes `missing`. CIF already includes freight and insurance. Example: CIF.

price_unit.description: landed_cost: unit of unit_price. Example: USD/metric ton.

quantity_unit.description: landed_cost: unit of quantity. Example: metric ton.

quote_currency.description: landed_cost: currency for the total. Needs fx_rate — no rate is sourced. Example: GHS.

rate_unit.description: fx_impact: direction of fx_rate, read not inferred. Example: GHS/USD means cedi per dollar.

usd_move_pct.description: fx_impact: percent the USD strengthens. Example: 5.

name: trade.calculate

components.description: Each part of the build-up, with where its number came from

missing.description: Inputs not supplied. Their components are excluded from the total, not defaulted.

title: Trade Calculation
